faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the One Stop Centre Attur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the One Stop Centre Attur Recruitment 2026 is 21 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies available for the Case Worker post in the One Stop Centre Attur Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum age requirement for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for all posts is 21 years.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Security Guard position is 40 years.

faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for SC/ST candidates, as well as for General/OBC candidates.

faq.answer: The selection process for these posts primarily involves Document Verification.

faq.answer: The salary for a Case Worker is Rs. 18800 per month.

faq.answer: Candidates need to have completed 10th or 12th grade and possess 2 years of relevant experience to be eligible for the Security Guard post.
